actions.name: Machine inspection and paytable verification
targets: M-1158 (Back Forty, Desert Gold, slot L-31-4)
assumptions: M-1158 hit rate 38.6% vs configured 31.5% over 674k spins (z = +124); observed hold 3.0% vs 10% configured
If the paytable is restored, house win returns to theo: +$200/day at the H1 coin-in of $2,871/day
Play volume stays the same after the fix (it may fall if players liked the looser game)
actions.uncertainty: Diagnosis is near-certain (a hit-rate gap this size is not luck); the cause is unknown (paytable, firmware, meter). Outcome is information first.
actions.measurement: After the fix, hit rate on the next 50,000 spins must be within 31.5% ± 0.4 pp (±2 SE); observed hold tracked weekly vs 10% theo hold.

actions.name: Property promotion weekend
targets: Slot-tournament weekend, Fri-Sun Jul 25-27 (after the 14-day lead)
actions.effect_unit: $ extra floor theo over the weekend
assumptions: High = Feb 21-23 Winter Slot Tournament: +$82,524 theo vs a normal Fri-Sun, no dip in the following days
Low = the weaker Locals Week format: +6.4% of a normal weekend
July demand ×0.95 vs Feb (LVCVA visitors and our June floor were both down)
Prizes, marketing and staffing are inside the $15,000 package
actions.uncertainty: Two past promotions gave +6% and +19%; the 14-day lead is shorter than the 4-week lead of the February event.
actions.measurement: Model B (weekday forecast, frozen on Jul 1) gives the counterfactual; lift = actual − forecast. Daily MAE is ~5%, so a 3-day lift above ~6% is distinguishable from noise. Check the next weekend for pull-forward.

actions.name: Wayfinding and signage refresh for a zone
targets: Back Forty (Z-B40): signs + sightlines on the Main Entrance walkway (W-ENT-B40) and at the Garage side
assumptions: Back Forty earns $13,283/day of theo (May-Jun); 20 days after the 10-day lead
The walkway closure proved its demand depends on access from the main entrance: ratio to the rest of the floor 0.669 -> 0.461 while closed, and only back to 0.643 after
Low +1%, mid +4.0% (closes the post-closure gap), high +8%; break-even = +2.8%
actions.uncertainty: No past signage change to learn from; the closure shows that access matters, not how much signs restore.
actions.measurement: Weekly Back Forty ÷ rest-of-floor theo per open hour vs the post-closure baseline 0.643 (weekly SD ≈ 0.01, so +3% is visible in ~3 weeks), plus Back Forty counter entries per sensor-day. No machine moves in the zone during the test.

rejected.name: Replace the GM's bottom-10 with leased machines
rejected.expected_benefit: ≈ $0 net in July: the 10 are average machines in a weak zone or low-hold games; a new cabinet in the same slot inherits the slot
rejected.reason: Model A decision test: the GM's 10 had a May-Jun location/game-adjusted index of 1.01 (average) and 0 of them were among the truly weakest 10.

rejected.name: Add a slot technician to the grave shift
rejected.reason: Grave-shift faults wait 2.0 h vs 0.7 h on a fully staffed swing shift, but only ~50 faults/month happen at night, when a machine-hour is worth $15.

rejected.name: Preventive maintenance, Ridgeline
rejected.expected_benefit: ≈ $4,551 if it prevents 25% of Ridgeline faults (repair cost + lost theo)
rejected.reason: Ridgeline faults are 2-3× the other brands per machine, but they already fell ~28% after March; no data on what preventive maintenance achieves.

rejected.name: Move strong games out of Back Forty (8 swap pairs)
rejected.reason: The zone × game model says the best games belong in the busiest zones, but in July only 1 pair(s) beat their own $3,600 cost by 10% (strong games that are weak for their spot are not promoted). It also confounds the signage test in the same zone: run it in August after the signs are measured.

rejected.name: Comp policy pilot with control group
rejected.expected_benefit: Information: is the May 1 comp price cut paying for itself?
rejected.reason: Strong #4. Carded coin-in rose 2.8% vs uncarded after May 1 (placebo ≈ 0), but that may be more card use rather than more play. Recommended next once a slot frees up.

rejected.name: Second promotion weekend
rejected.expected_benefit: Unknown until the first one is measured
rejected.reason: Test one, measure against the frozen forecast, then scale.

rejected.name: Bigger guest survey / purchased machine / floor-wide comp change
rejected.reason: No evidence linking them to the causes we found; a purchase ($22,000) has 9 operating days in the horizon.

sensitivity.scenario: All three actions at LOW effect
Inspection finds nothing, promotion and signs MID
Promotion only at the weak Locals-week lift, no seasonality discount
